notes: rust:1.40 (tc-rust). No dependencies. Full suite incl. unit tests, tests/lib.rs. Doc-tests are excluded (--lib --tests): the harness cargo parser cannot parse doc-test names, which contain spaces. build_cmd touches src/*.rs inside the container so cargo's mtime fingerprint never reuses a stale build after the harness restores a file with its original (2019) mtime. Reproducibility: the exact dependency versions are fixed by the shipped lockfile benchmark/lockfiles/rust__strsim-rs.Cargo.lock, which `tc.py setup` copies into the working copy; setup_cmd then only downloads them (cargo fetch --locked). `setup_cmd_generate` is the original command that produced that lockfile in Oct 2026 (it resolves unpinned dependencies against the live registry, so it is kept for provenance only).
